messages:
maria: noticed p99 jump in lisbon pop since 12:03 UTC, traces show kvcache miss rate spiking and kernel selector oscillating.
aj: on it — is this isolated to lisbon? any cross-pop fallbacks triggered?
maria: yes, only LIS. No fallbacks, traffic stayed pinned; observed repeated DNS hairpin to frankfurt (AS123) then back; RTT jump ~150ms.
devon: can you paste the runtime profiler snapshot? especially kernel selection logs.
maria: pasted below
```
[2026-03-18T12:03:11Z] profile: selected_kernel=v1_optimized cpu_ms=2.1 kv_hits=120 kv_misses=29 batch_size=8
[2026-03-18T12:03:12Z] profile: selected_kernel=v2_lowlat cpu_ms=1.8 kv_hits=40 kv_misses=131 batch_size=1
[2026-03-18T12:03:14Z] profile: kernel_switch reason=batch_drop->latency_surge
```
li: that pattern screams noisy-host causing KV cache churn + batch collapse. If the host sees higher RTT, batching reduces which triggers kernel switch to low-latency path w/ worse kvcache locality.
aj: any noisy tenants or recent deploys in LIS pool?
maria: tenant affinity shows a new large customer started heavy concurrent short-inference load at 12:01 UTC.
sam: infra-bot, can we get per-host netstat and dns cache before/after?
infra-bot: collected artifacts: /artifacts/lisbon/2745123456/netstat.log, /artifacts/lisbon/2745123456/dns-cache.dump
maria: netstat shows many short TCP connections to external LDNS causing hairpin toward FRA AS123. dns-cache dump TTLs show repeated NX re-resolves for our internal ldns IP (odd).
devon: hypothesis: ldns misroute triggers hairpin + asymmetric path increases latency -> batching heuristics see higher per-request latency -> batch size falls -> kernel selection flips -> kvcache miss rate skyrockets -> p99 spikes.
aj: can we test by force-routing to local egress (bypass LDNS) and lock kernel to v1_optimized for a canary?
li: I can push a local route override to avoid AS123 for lisbon pop for small subset.
maria: also trying a kernel pin on the pod: `RUNTIME_KERNEL=force:v1_optimized` on 3 replicas.
(5m later)
maria: after temporary route override + kernel pin p99 dropped from 420ms -> 110ms, kv_miss rate halved, batching returned to size 8.
sam: thumbs up. we should add a guard: if kvcache miss rate > 50% and kernel oscillation frequency > 3/min, pin kernel and alert netops.
aj: open a followup ticket for autosafeguard + add LDNS healthcheck monitors for hairpin detection.
maria: creating ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-9876
devon: also add a lightweight profiler that triggers when batch_size variance > threshold to avoid late kernel flips.
li: filing infra PR to block AS123 egress for lisbon on canary: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/502
maria: notes for postmortem: root cause = external LDNS hairpin causing cross-pop RTT jumps -> batching heuristic reacted -> kernel selector oscillated amplifying kvcache misses -> noisy-tenant exacerbated.
sam: add remediation steps + long-term: make batching heuristic incorporate kvcache hit rate and avoid kernel flip for short transients.
aj: thanks team. keep artifacts pinned in incident channel.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: route-override-canary -> 3/3 success
maria: closing thread here, will paste postmortem draft to incidents channel shortly :thumbsup:
